blurb: Guests fly from Harris Airport (83K) in Fort Ann, NY, on scenic helicopter tours ranging from five to sixty minutes over Lake George, the High Peaks, and the Green Mountains. They also offer FAA Part 61 helicopter flight training and discovery flights with hands-on controls under instructor supervision. Tours operate mainly May through October, with training year-round and off-season tours by appointment.
extraNote: Full refund if cancelled more than 48 hours before flight · 50% credit toward future flight if cancelled 24–48 hours before · Forfeit if cancelled less than 24 hours before, except for weather · Pilot has sole authority over weather cancellations; weather cancellations get rebook or refund · One free reschedule if more than 48 hours' notice given · No tipping expected; gratuity appreciated and goes 100% to pilot · Harris Airport (83K), Fort Ann, NY · Tours busiest May through October; training year-round; off-season tours by appointment
